image_description: A wooden altar situated within a stone alcove featuring arched architecture. The altar is a raised rectangular structure with a flat top surface covered by a white cloth. It features decorative carvings, including a central niche and side panels with symbols (possibly an anchor). Two tall candlesticks flank the altar. Above the altar is a large, ornate wooden frame resembling a reredos or mirror frame, set against the back wall of the alcove.

artifact_observations.location: Wood grain on altar front panels
artifact_observations.reasoning: The wood grain texture appears slightly repetitive and lacks the fine, random variation of real wood, suggesting a procedural or AI-generated texture pattern. It looks somewhat 'painted on' rather than intrinsic to the material.

The central black rectangular niche lacks depth cues or interior detail. It appears as a flat black void rather than a recessed space, which is a common AI artifact where internal geometry fails to render correctly.
The bases of the candlesticks do not sit perfectly flush with the altar top; there is slight ambiguity in the contact shadow, making them appear to float slightly or merge subtly with the surface.

The decorative elements on the vertical sides of the large wooden frame above the altar are irregular and lack clear structural logic. Some protrusions seem to melt into the frame rather than being distinct carved elements.
